Hero.lead: Born from the Environment Centre of the University of Lubumbashi–Society Interface, EWES brings together a multidisciplinary team of Congolese and international experts to meet its clients’ needs, whatever the nature of the project.
Hero.imageAlt: Water infrastructure set in a river landscape

World.title: Mining and oil environmental experts.
World.description: A limited liability company, EWES has established itself in drawing up and assessing the environmental plans of mining and oil projects: natural and man-made risk studies, site development, environmental compliance and training of the sector’s managers and technicians.
World.addressLine1: 1809, Araucarias Avenue, Hewa-Bora district, Ruashi commune, Lubumbashi.
World.networkLine: Our work is carried out in collaboration with Belgian, French and Canadian partners.
World.imageAlt: EWES engineering team on a field mission

values.title: A multidisciplinary team
values.text: Congolese and international experts and consultants from environmental sciences, earth sciences and technology.

values.title: Mining and oil experience
values.text: Environmental studies carried out for many mining operators, and support to Congolese State services.

values.title: Training as a commitment

World.teamText: EWES relies on a multidisciplinary team of Congolese and international experts and consultants whose expertise covers environmental sciences, earth sciences and technology.
World.clientsText: Environmental studies carried out for the benefit of mining companies such as:

Expertises.title: Serving companies, the State and research.

items.title: Mining, oil and mineral sectors
items.text: Feasibility studies, optimisation of operating conditions, environmental incidence studies.

items.title: The Congolese State
items.text: Environmental audits, restoration of polluted sites, characterisation of deposits on concessions to be awarded.

items.title: Continuing education
items.text: Coaching and refresher training for staff and managers of mining and mineral companies based in the DRC.

items.title: Researcher supervision
items.text: Support for private and public sector researchers in environment, water and engineering works.

Research.title: Data and methods adapted to local realities.
Research.description: EWES’s research activities pursue four objectives.

items.title: Measure and model
items.text: Produce quantified data on the state of the environment and model how it evolves under different scenarios.

items.title: Support public authorities
items.text: Develop knowledge and tools that help authorities manage the environment sector.

items.title: Support industry
items.text: Help industrial companies build environmental protection criteria into their processes.

items.title: Remediate locally
items.text: Establish remediation methods that fit local realities.

Water.title: The whole water chain, from resource to use.
Water.description: From feasibility study to training of stakeholders, EWES supports the sustainable management of water resources, including in industrial settings.

services.title: Water supply feasibility
services.desc: Feasibility studies for drinking water supply projects.

services.title: Sustainable resource management
services.desc: Water resource management designed for the long term.

services.title: Intake & drinking water supply
services.desc: Water intake and delivery all the way to users.

services.title: Water treatment
services.desc: Treatment processes adapted to the resource and the intended use.

services.title: Wastewater purification
services.desc: Purification of wastewater before it returns to the environment.

services.title: Water quality analysis
services.desc: Analyses to monitor and document water quality.

services.title: Training of water stakeholders
services.desc: Training for stakeholders in the water sector.

Environment.title: Measure, assess, protect.
Environment.description: Studies, audits, monitoring and analyses: EWES supports industrial operators and institutions in controlling their environmental impact.

services.title: Environmental impact study
services.text: Assessing the effects of a project on its surroundings.

services.title: Environmental audit
services.text: Review of environmental practices and compliance.

services.title: Continuous monitoring
services.text: Ongoing monitoring of the state of the environment.

services.title: Water, soil and materials
services.text: Analysis of water, soil and various materials.

services.title: Eco-design
services.text: Building the environment into design from the start.

Engineering.title: Design, equip, support.
Engineering.description: Alongside the environment and water activities, EWES carries out engineering works: analytical instruments, building construction, IT and electricity.

items.title: Analytical instruments
items.text: Advice, supply, repair and training: pH meters, conductivity meters, gas analysers, and more.

items.title: Building construction
items.text: Computer-aided design, scale models, computer-aided site supervision and training in construction software.

items.title: IT
items.text: An IT activity complements EWES’s engineering offering.

items.title: Electricity
items.text: Engineering works in the field of electricity.

Training.title: Strengthening the skills of local stakeholders.
Training.description: Training is an essential part of EWES’s activities: the company shares its expertise with managers and technicians of mining and oil companies, as well as with the public services in charge of the environment in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
Training.text: Courses are tailored to each client’s needs and delivered by Congolese and international experts and consultants specialising in environmental sciences, earth sciences and technology. They help promote a more sustainable and responsible approach to the exploitation of natural resources.

AboutPage.title: Born at university, focused on the field.
AboutPage.description: EWES SARL grew out of the Environment Centre of the University of Lubumbashi–Society Interface (IUS). With a multidisciplinary team of Congolese and international experts, it works in environment, water and engineering works, in collaboration with Belgian, French and Canadian partners.
